assessment.author: Harvey / ChatGPT
assessment.decision_type: Advice only; not an order or a prediction of today's high
assessment.conclusion: Reduce excessive leverage first, then observe with a smaller remaining position. Recovering cost basis is not itself a market signal.
assessment.illustrative_plan: Propose reducing 60 of 110 shares and retaining at most 50, conditional on executable prices and the portfolio leverage ceiling. Do not treat this as an executed sale.
assessment.cap_interpretation: Calculations provisionally interpret 40% as the combined market value of leveraged ETFs divided by current total investment assets including cash. If the policy instead means look-through notional exposure, substantially fewer SOXL shares are permissible.
assessment.reference_price_status: User-supplied reference only; not independently verified as a current executable price
assessment.cap_condition: The minimum total-assets calculation assumes no other leveraged holdings. Use current same-currency portfolio values and round permissible shares down.

scenario_not_forecast.assumptions: Reference price 131.61 USD; ignores fees and taxes; cash proceeds not reinvested. Positive moves also provide less upside after reduction.

assessment.execution_notes: Verify the actual bid, spread, order-session eligibility and estimated proceeds in the brokerage app. Prefer price-controlled limit orders, recognizing non-execution risk. Do not wait for an additional profit target merely to correct a violated allocation ceiling.
assessment.remaining_position_notes: Respect the allocation ceiling regardless of whether the sector thesis survives. No technical support, stop price or upward price target was verified in this assessment.
assessment.uncertainty: Short-term direction is uncertain. This review does not establish that the rebound will continue, reverse, or persist into the regular session.
